period.name: confirmation
period.input_sample: Existing E0031 common T-60/T-59/Gamma economic decision ledger only

entry_policy.decision: Use frozen candidate probability and exact saved T-60 native best asks; calculate expected net payout on the requested gross amount; consider a side only when the saved single-level ask can fill it; require strictly positive expected net payout; choose the positive maximum and break exact ties toward UP.
entry_policy.free_cash_control_basis: free cash immediately before the T-60 decision after releasing only positions whose assumed payout availability time has passed
entry_policy.minimum_order_source: D0004; historical Gamma orderMinSize is unavailable
entry_policy.execution: Use only the existing verified T-59 native ask ladders; walk depth for the requested notional with existing fee/rounding rules; accept full fills only.

settlement_accounting.official_outcome_source: Saved Gamma one-hot official UP/DOWN outcomes; never substitute the Binance proxy.
settlement_accounting.payout_delay_evidence: Reused frozen E0031 account rule; actual redemption availability timestamps are not archived. This is an idealized assumption, not a verified conservative bound on real redemption latency.
settlement_accounting.position_end_event: One official resolution payout, including zero payout for a losing token; no sale or sale-fee event is created.
settlement_accounting.locked_cost_basis: Keep the gross purchase amount locked until assumed payout availability; do not release at market end or outcome-known time alone.
settlement_accounting.equity_path: free cash + locked gross cost basis; report peak-to-trough drawdown and retain unresolved positions at the sample cutoff

fees.treatment: Preserve existing fee regime, one-time debit, V1 share-fee and V2 cash-fee treatment; no rebate sensitivity.

analysis_limits.uncertainty: Retain E0030/E0031 paired non-circular 3-day moving-block intervals for predictive comparisons; do not treat trades as independent. Portfolio-path uncertainty is not estimated because no frozen bootstrap protocol for the stateful account exists in the saved experiment.
